initial.chief_complaint: Acute interscapular pain followed by progressive bilateral leg weakness and bowel/bladder incontinence.

presenting_complaint: Acute interscapular pain followed by progressive bilateral leg weakness and bowel/bladder incontinence.
history_freetext:
Nonradiating interscapular pain began two days before presentation; leg weakness progressed to inability to stand, with perineal sensory loss and bowel/bladder incontinence.
No trauma, heavy lifting, fever, recent vaccination, chronic illness, known anticoagulant or other prior medication use.
